body:
my use case is as follows:
i have 36 000 projects linked to 40 000 companies.
Client requirement is to find companies that has worked on this or that project (with other facets also)

so i imagined the flow :
there is input allowing the user to search in the projet list. there is some kind of autocomplete or more likely a results list (capped to a maximum result i guess)
the user can click and select a project from the result list to add it to the search. Here companies results listing is refined
he can then search another projet and click and select it to add it to the search.Here companies results listing is refined
the 2 previous selected project should be easily removable as well.
